_comment: Optional when deploying to a platform host. For a single clinic, skip this file entirely and set GATEWAY_CLINIC_ID, GATEWAY_PROJECT_ID and GATEWAY_PHONE_NUMBER as environment variables instead; env wins on a matching clinicId. This file is for several clinics, or for pointing a service-account key at a non-standard path (GATEWAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH). TWILIO_* env vars override the sms block when both are set.

sms._comment: Optional SMS fallback (Twilio) for access codes and high-priority reminders when WhatsApp delivery fails. Omit to disable.
